author: Barbatos Labs
name: Barbatos.Wpf App (Aquarius + Core + i18n)
description: A starter WPF app referencing Barbatos.Wpf.Core, and optionally Barbatos.Wpf.Aquarius, Barbatos.Wpf.AquariusRouter, Barbatos.Wpf.AquariusValee, and Barbatos.i18n, wired together - tick the modules you want (Visual Studio) or pass --Include* flags (CLI/Rider).

PackageVersion.description: Version of Barbatos.Wpf.Core/Aquarius/AquariusRouter/AquariusValee to reference - override with --PackageVersion if it has moved on from the default by the time you use this. Not yet published to nuget.org as of this writing - see templates/README.md.

IncludeAquarius.description: Adds Barbatos.Wpf.Aquarius: Ref<T>/Setup.ViewModel wiring and a Count demo.

IncludeAquariusRouter.description: Adds Barbatos.Wpf.AquariusRouter: a minimal Home/About route table, RouterView outlet, RouterLink nav, and an in-app route search box. Requires Aquarius - automatically included even if 'Aquarius' above is left unchecked.

IncludeValee.description: Adds Barbatos.Wpf.AquariusValee: a SignUpView whose Form/Field state drives DataAnnotations validation, with Valee.Field/PasswordField/Mask/Numeric bound to real controls. Requires Aquarius - automatically included even if 'Aquarius' above is left unchecked.

IncludeI18n.description: Adds Barbatos.i18n.Wpf/DependencyInjection: {i18n:StringLocalizer}, an English/Vietnamese greeting, and a language switch.

IncludeSingleInstance.description: A second launch attempt is blocked and brings the first instance's window to the foreground.

IncludeRunOnStartup.description: Registers/unregisters the app to launch when Windows starts.

IncludeTrayIcon.description: Adds a tray icon with Open/Exit menu items.

IncludeKeepAwake.description: Prevents the system from sleeping while enabled at runtime.

IncludeNotifications.description: Registers INotificationService for Windows toast notifications.

IncludePushNotifications.description: Registers the SignalR-based push notification client (disabled by default - no server configured).

IncludePeriodicServices.description: Adds a HeartbeatService.cs sample IWpfPeriodicService, ticking every 5 seconds.

IncludeInputSystem.description: Adds an example in-app keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+F9 shows the main window).

IncludeDialogs.description: Adds IDialogService plus a minimal AboutWindow shown through it.

IncludeMcp.description: Registers the MCP client with a zero-setup NuGet MCP server. No AI provider/API key is configured - bring your own key.

IncludeSplashScreen.description: Shows the built-in SplashScreen while the app starts.
